name: Synthetic Fantasy;
source:
Do you feel lonely?

Observe this story as a member of the audience and witness this tale of love and friendship and find out the answer to the ultimate question:

Can YOU learn to love?

This is the question the protagonist, Dan Garland, will learn the answer to as he is caught between his fiance and an android. 


Hopefully you will do so too, player.

[From [url=https://lonelyrabbitgames.itch.io/synthetic-fantasy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你感到孤独吗？

作为观众来观察这个故事，见证这个爱情与友情的故事，找出终极问题的答案：

你能学会爱吗？

这是主角丹·加兰（Dan Garland）夹在未婚夫和机器人之间时将得到答案的问题。


希望你也能这样做，玩家。

[来自[url=https://lonelyrabbitgames.itch.io/synthetic-fantasy]itch.io[/url]]
